nodes.label: node-red CLI
nodes.desc: Parses flags and settings.js, builds the express app, then calls RED.init and RED.start.

nodes.label: lib/red.js wiring
nodes.desc: Embeds @node-red/runtime and @node-red/editor-api into one process and hands the runtime API to the editor.

nodes.label: Admin HTTP API
nodes.desc: Express routes the browser editor calls: GET/POST /flows, /nodes, /context, /settings.

nodes.label: WebSocket /comms
nodes.desc: Authenticated websocket for live editor traffic: subscribe requests, topics, heartbeats.

nodes.label: Runtime flows API
nodes.desc: Mutex-serialized getFlows/setFlows; rejects a deploy whose rev does not match with 409.

nodes.label: Runtime comms bus
nodes.desc: Publishes node-status and runtime events to editor connections, keeping retained topics.

nodes.label: Flow manager
nodes.desc: Loads flow JSON from storage, diffs configs, and drives the deploy cycle: stop, clean context, start.

nodes.label: Flow instance
nodes.desc: One Flow object per tab: instantiates nodes and routes SendEvents through hook stages to node.receive.

nodes.label: Node base class
nodes.desc: Every node extends this: wires-aware send, receive, lazy context, error and status reporting.

nodes.label: Type registry
nodes.desc: Maps node type strings to constructors via registerNodeConstructor and emits type-registered.

nodes.label: Module loader
nodes.desc: Scans core nodes and the userDir node_modules tree, then requires and registers each node set.

nodes.label: Context stores
nodes.desc: Node, flow and global context backed by pluggable stores: memory by default, or file/Redis-style plugins.
